description: This file defines the Startup model class within the Opencart Catalog's Setting namespace. The class contains a method to retrieve start-up configurations from the database, specifically fetching active startup entries ordered by their sort order.

classes.name: Startup
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing startup configurations within the OpenCart catalog settings.

methods.name: getStartups
methods.description: Retrieves an array of active startup entries from the database, ordered by their sort order.
